These delicious gummies deliver a blend of essential vitamins and minerals to help maintain tissue health, promote energy metabolism, and support key functions from vision to immunity. blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Nourish your body daily with our Organic Women’s Multivitamin Gummies, thoughtfully formulated to support your daily wellness! These delicious gummies deliver a blend of essential vitamins and minerals to help maintain tissue health, promote energy metabolism, and support key functions from vision to immunity. With carefully selected nutrients like vitamins A, C, D, E, and a range of B vitamins — plus iodine, zinc, and selenium — this formula helps fill nutritional gaps while supporting the unique needs of women.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Ages 14+, take up to 2 gummies daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Organic glucose syrup, organic cane sugar, purified water, pectin, organic maltodextrin, citric acid, organic sunflower oil, organic vegetable juice color, organic fruit juice color, natural flavors, organic carnauba wax, and sodium citrate.
All ingredients are vegan and Non-GMO.
This product is made without: Gelatin, peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish, gluten, milk, eggs, soy, sesame, and mustard.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children.

We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs.
